requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: What the movant was charged with, worded exactly as the court record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: What the movant was charged with, worded exactly as the court record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: what you were charged with, worded exactly as the court record words it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Disposition of the case - how it ended, and the date of final disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Disposition of the case - how it ended, and the date of final disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the case ended and on what date, checked against the disposition you obtain from the court in step two - correct the packet if they disagree

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own statement of why the offence did not occur, or why the movant was not the person who committed it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own statement of why the offence did not occur, or why the movant was not the person who committed it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the showing of actual innocence is the movant's own evidentiary burden; the platform judges nothing and writes none of it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own first-hand account of why the offence did not occur or why you were not the person who committed it - you carry the burden of demonstrating it by a preponderance of the evidence, and the packet does not write it for you

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Prior expungement motions like this one you have filed, and when each was resolved
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Prior expungement motions like this one you have filed, and when each was resolved
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: any earlier motion like this one and when it was resolved - write NONE if none; a second motion waits one year after the first is resolved, a third and final one year after the second, though a motion on different grounds may be filed at any time

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Statement of points and authorities, exhibits, affidavits and supporting documents attached to the motion
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Statement of points and authorities, exhibits, affidavits and supporting documents attached to the motion
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the movant carries the burden and supplies the supporting material
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the supporting material you attach - points and authorities, exhibits, affidavits and supporting documents; you supply them and the platform does not judge sufficiency

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the case this motion addresses
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the case this motion addresses
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number, copied exactly from the court record - the disposition you request in step two of the filing instructions states it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting office for the case
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting office for the case
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no held source states the prosecutor-routing rule or a service address, so the participant obtains both from the named checkable authority
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and mailing address of the office that prosecuted your case - the United States Attorney's Office for the District of Columbia or the Office of the Attorney General for the District of Columbia; the Criminal Division clerk's office (202-879-1373) or the Seal Team (criminalmotionsealteam@dcsc.gov) can tell you which, and the address
